title: Smart Elevator – Analyse & Prognose
description: Verhaltensanalyse nach Tageszeit, Forecast, Wetter-Korrelation (DWD Heilbronn)

list.definition: SELECT name FROM elevators ORDER BY name
list.name: elevator
list.label: Aufzug
list.query: SELECT name FROM elevators ORDER BY name

panels.title: Ø Fahrten pro Tagesstunde – Betätigungsmuster
panels.description: Erkennbare Peaks: Arbeitsbeginn (~7–9 Uhr), Mittagspause (~11:30–13 Uhr), Feierabend (~16–18 Uhr).

targets.rawSql: WITH hours AS (SELECT generate_series(0, 23) AS h) SELECT LPAD(hours.h::text, 2, '0') || ':00' AS "Uhrzeit", COALESCE(ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN d.elevator_name = 'Aufzug links L-Bau' THEN d.avg_trips_per_hour ELSE 0 END)::numeric, 2), 0) AS "Links L-Bau", COALESCE(ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN d.elevator_name = 'Aufzug rechts L-Bau' THEN d.avg_trips_per_hour ELSE 0 END)::numeric, 2), 0) AS "Rechts L-Bau", COALESCE(ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN d.elevator_name = 'Feuerwehraufzug L-Bau' THEN d.avg_trips_per_hour ELSE 0 END)::numeric, 2), 0) AS "Feuerwehr", COALESCE(ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN d.elevator_name = 'Campus Brücken HN West' THEN d.avg_trips_per_hour ELSE 0 END)::numeric, 2), 0) AS "Campus HN West", COALESCE(ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN d.elevator_name = 'Campus Brücken HN Ost' THEN d.avg_trips_per_hour ELSE 0 END)::numeric, 2), 0) AS "Campus HN Ost", COALESCE(ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN d.elevator_name = 'Teststand lipah Aufzüge Heilbronn' THEN d.avg_trips_per_hour ELSE 0 END)::numeric, 2), 0) AS "Teststand" FROM hours LEFT JOIN v_hourly_pattern d ON d.hour_of_day = hours.h AND d.elevator_name IN ($elevator) GROUP BY hours.h ORDER BY hours.h

panels.title: Ø Fahrten pro Wochentag
panels.description: Montag–Freitag erwartet höhere Nutzung als Wochenende.

targets.rawSql: SELECT CASE day_of_week WHEN 0 THEN 'So' WHEN 1 THEN 'Mo' WHEN 2 THEN 'Di' WHEN 3 THEN 'Mi' WHEN 4 THEN 'Do' WHEN 5 THEN 'Fr' WHEN 6 THEN 'Sa' END AS "Wochentag", ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN elevator_name = 'Aufzug links L-Bau'     THEN avg_trips_per_day ELSE 0 END)::numeric, 1) AS "Links L-Bau", ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN elevator_name = 'Aufzug rechts L-Bau'    THEN avg_trips_per_day ELSE 0 END)::numeric, 1) AS "Rechts L-Bau", ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN elevator_name = 'Campus Brücken HN West' THEN avg_trips_per_day ELSE 0 END)::numeric, 1) AS "Campus HN", ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN elevator_name = 'Feuerwehraufzug L-Bau'  THEN avg_trips_per_day ELSE 0 END)::numeric, 1) AS "Feuerwehr", ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN elevator_name = 'Campus Brücken HN Ost'              THEN avg_trips_per_day ELSE 0 END)::numeric, 1) AS "Campus HN Ost", ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN elevator_name = 'Teststand lipah Aufzüge Heilbronn' THEN avg_trips_per_day ELSE 0 END)::numeric, 1) AS "Teststand lipah" FROM v_weekday_pattern WHERE elevator_name IN ($elevator) GROUP BY day_of_week ORDER BY day_of_week

panels.title: Top-Stunden nach Auslastung
panels.description: Die 10 betrieblichsten Stunden gemittelt über alle gewählten Aufzüge.

targets.rawSql: SELECT LPAD(hour_of_day::text, 2, '0') || ':00 Uhr' AS "Tageszeit", ROUND(AVG(avg_trips_per_hour)::numeric, 2) AS "Ø Fahrten", CASE WHEN hour_of_day BETWEEN 7 AND 9 THEN '☀️ Arbeitsbeginn' WHEN hour_of_day BETWEEN 11 AND 13 THEN '🍽️ Mittagspause' WHEN hour_of_day BETWEEN 16 AND 18 THEN '🏠 Feierabend' ELSE '' END AS "Zeitfenster" FROM v_hourly_pattern WHERE elevator_name IN ($elevator) GROUP BY hour_of_day ORDER BY "Ø Fahrten" DESC LIMIT 10

panels.title: Fahrtenverlauf & 7-Tage-Gleitender Durchschnitt
panels.description: Tatsächliche Tagesfahrten kombiniert mit dem 7-Tage-Trend als gestrichelte Linie.

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('day', time) AS "time", COUNT(*) AS "Links L-Bau" FROM elevator_events ev JOIN elevators e ON e.id = ev.elevator_id WHERE e.name = 'Aufzug links L-Bau' AND $__timeFilter(ev.time) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT day AS "time", ROUND(AVG(cnt) OVER (ORDER BY day ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)::numeric, 1) AS "7-Tage-Trend (Links)" FROM (SELECT date_trunc('day', time) AS day, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM elevator_events ev JOIN elevators e ON e.id = ev.elevator_id WHERE e.name = 'Aufzug links L-Bau' AND $__timeFilter(ev.time) GROUP BY 1) t ORDER BY day

SELECT date_trunc('day', time) AS "time", COUNT(*) AS "Rechts L-Bau" FROM elevator_events ev JOIN elevators e ON e.id = ev.elevator_id WHERE e.name = 'Aufzug rechts L-Bau' AND $__timeFilter(ev.time) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT day AS "time", ROUND(AVG(cnt) OVER (ORDER BY day ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)::numeric, 1) AS "7-Tage-Trend (Rechts)" FROM (SELECT date_trunc('day', time) AS day, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM elevator_events ev JOIN elevators e ON e.id = ev.elevator_id WHERE e.name = 'Aufzug rechts L-Bau' AND $__timeFilter(ev.time) GROUP BY 1) t ORDER BY day

SELECT date_trunc('day', time) AS "time", COUNT(*) AS "Campus HN West" FROM (SELECT time, floor, LAG(floor) OVER (PARTITION BY elevator_id ORDER BY time) AS prev_floor FROM elevator_events ev JOIN elevators e ON e.id = ev.elevator_id WHERE e.name = 'Campus Brücken HN West' AND $__timeFilter(ev.time)) sub WHERE floor != prev_floor OR prev_floor IS NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT day AS "time", ROUND(AVG(cnt) OVER (ORDER BY day ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)::numeric, 1) AS "7-Tage-Trend (Campus)" FROM (SELECT date_trunc('day', time) AS day, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM (SELECT time, floor, LAG(floor) OVER (PARTITION BY elevator_id ORDER BY time) AS prev_floor FROM elevator_events ev JOIN elevators e ON e.id = ev.elevator_id WHERE e.name = 'Campus Brücken HN West' AND $__timeFilter(ev.time)) sub WHERE floor != prev_floor OR prev_floor IS NULL GROUP BY 1) t ORDER BY day

SELECT date_trunc('day', time) AS "time", COUNT(*) AS "Campus HN Ost" FROM (SELECT time, floor, LAG(floor) OVER (PARTITION BY elevator_id ORDER BY time) AS prev_floor FROM elevator_events ev JOIN elevators e ON e.id = ev.elevator_id WHERE e.name = 'Campus Brücken HN Ost' AND $__timeFilter(ev.time)) sub WHERE floor != prev_floor OR prev_floor IS NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT date_trunc('day', time) AS "time", COUNT(*) AS "Teststand" FROM (SELECT time, floor, LAG(floor) OVER (PARTITION BY elevator_id ORDER BY time) AS prev_floor FROM elevator_events ev JOIN elevators e ON e.id = ev.elevator_id WHERE e.name = 'Teststand lipah Aufzüge Heilbronn' AND $__timeFilter(ev.time)) sub WHERE floor != prev_floor OR prev_floor IS NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: 14-Tage-ML-Prognose (LightGBM) mit 80 % Konfidenzband
panels.description: Historische Ist-Werte + LightGBM Quantile-Regression mit 80%-Konfidenzband. Features: Wochentag, Lag-7, Rolling-Mittel, DWD-Wetterdaten. Taeglich um 02:00 Uhr neu trainiert (forecast_service.py --loop). Campus HN West zeigt Live-API-Daten (Elevision) bis heute.

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('day', time) AS "time", COUNT(*) AS "Ist Links L-Bau" FROM elevator_events ev JOIN elevators e ON e.id = ev.elevator_id WHERE e.name = 'Aufzug links L-Bau' AND $__timeFilter(ev.time) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT time AS "time", forecast_trips AS "ML Links L-Bau" FROM v_latest_forecast WHERE elevator_name = 'Aufzug links L-Bau' AND elevator_name IN ($elevator) AND $__timeFilter(time) ORDER BY time
SELECT time AS "time", ci_upper AS "CI oben Links" FROM v_latest_forecast WHERE elevator_name = 'Aufzug links L-Bau' AND elevator_name IN ($elevator) AND $__timeFilter(time) ORDER BY time
SELECT time AS "time", ci_lower AS "CI unten Links" FROM v_latest_forecast WHERE elevator_name = 'Aufzug links L-Bau' AND elevator_name IN ($elevator) AND $__timeFilter(time) ORDER BY time

SELECT date_trunc('day', time) AS "time", COUNT(*) AS "Ist Rechts L-Bau" FROM elevator_events ev JOIN elevators e ON e.id = ev.elevator_id WHERE e.name = 'Aufzug rechts L-Bau' AND $__timeFilter(ev.time) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT time AS "time", forecast_trips AS "ML Rechts L-Bau" FROM v_latest_forecast WHERE elevator_name = 'Aufzug rechts L-Bau' AND elevator_name IN ($elevator) AND $__timeFilter(time) ORDER BY time

SELECT date_trunc('day', time) AS "time", COUNT(*) AS "Ist Campus HN West" FROM (SELECT time, floor, LAG(floor) OVER (PARTITION BY elevator_id ORDER BY time) AS prev_floor FROM elevator_events ev JOIN elevators e ON e.id = ev.elevator_id WHERE e.name = 'Campus Brücken HN West' AND $__timeFilter(ev.time)) sub WHERE floor != prev_floor OR prev_floor IS NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT time AS "time", forecast_trips AS "ML Campus HN West" FROM v_latest_forecast WHERE elevator_name = 'Campus Brücken HN West' AND $__timeFilter(time) ORDER BY time

panels.title: Ø Erwartete Fahrten morgen
panels.description: Hochrechnung basierend auf dem historischen Wochentagsmuster.

targets.rawSql: SELECT ROUND(avg_per_day::numeric, 0) AS "Links L-Bau" FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) * 1.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT date_trunc('day', time)), 0) AS avg_per_day FROM elevator_events ev JOIN elevators e ON e.id = ev.elevator_id WHERE e.name = 'Aufzug links L-Bau' AND EXTRACT(DOW FROM time)::int = EXTRACT(DOW FROM NOW() + INTERVAL '1 day')::int) t

SELECT ROUND(avg_per_day::numeric, 0) AS "Rechts L-Bau" FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) * 1.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT date_trunc('day', time)), 0) AS avg_per_day FROM elevator_events ev JOIN elevators e ON e.id = ev.elevator_id WHERE e.name = 'Aufzug rechts L-Bau' AND EXTRACT(DOW FROM time)::int = EXTRACT(DOW FROM NOW() + INTERVAL '1 day')::int) t

SELECT ROUND(avg_per_day::numeric, 0) AS "Campus HN" FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) * 1.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT date_trunc('day', time)), 0) AS avg_per_day FROM elevator_events ev JOIN elevators e ON e.id = ev.elevator_id WHERE e.name = 'Campus Brücken HN West' AND EXTRACT(DOW FROM time)::int = EXTRACT(DOW FROM NOW() + INTERVAL '1 day')::int) t

panels.title: Temperatur vs. Aufzugsfahrten
panels.description: Duale Achse: Fahrten/Tag je Aufzug (links) und Tagesdurchschnittstemperatur (rechts, orange). Filter steuert welche Aufzuege angezeigt werden.

targets.rawSql: SELECT time AS "time", trip_count AS "Links L-Bau" FROM v_elevator_weather_daily WHERE elevator_name = 'Aufzug links L-Bau' AND elevator_name IN ($elevator) AND $__timeFilter(time) ORDER BY time
SELECT time AS "time", trip_count AS "Rechts L-Bau" FROM v_elevator_weather_daily WHERE elevator_name = 'Aufzug rechts L-Bau' AND elevator_name IN ($elevator) AND $__timeFilter(time) ORDER BY time
SELECT time AS "time", trip_count AS "Campus HN" FROM v_elevator_weather_daily WHERE elevator_name = 'Campus Brücken HN West' AND elevator_name IN ($elevator) AND $__timeFilter(time) ORDER BY time
SELECT time AS "time", trip_count AS "Feuerwehr" FROM v_elevator_weather_daily WHERE elevator_name = 'Feuerwehraufzug L-Bau' AND elevator_name IN ($elevator) AND $__timeFilter(time) ORDER BY time
SELECT DISTINCT time AS "time", temperature_avg AS "Temp. Avg (C)" FROM v_elevator_weather_daily WHERE elevator_name = 'Aufzug links L-Bau' AND $__timeFilter(time) ORDER BY time
SELECT time AS "time", trip_count AS "Campus HN Ost" FROM v_elevator_weather_daily WHERE elevator_name = 'Campus Brücken HN Ost' AND elevator_name IN ($elevator) AND $__timeFilter(time) ORDER BY time

SELECT time AS "time", trip_count AS "Teststand lipah" FROM v_elevator_weather_daily WHERE elevator_name = 'Teststand lipah Aufzüge Heilbronn' AND elevator_name IN ($elevator) AND $__timeFilter(time) ORDER BY time

targets.rawSql: SELECT time AS "time", trip_count AS "Links L-Bau" FROM v_elevator_weather_daily WHERE elevator_name = 'Aufzug links L-Bau' AND elevator_name IN ($elevator) AND $__timeFilter(time) ORDER BY time
SELECT time AS "time", trip_count AS "Rechts L-Bau" FROM v_elevator_weather_daily WHERE elevator_name = 'Aufzug rechts L-Bau' AND elevator_name IN ($elevator) AND $__timeFilter(time) ORDER BY time
SELECT time AS "time", trip_count AS "Campus HN" FROM v_elevator_weather_daily WHERE elevator_name = 'Campus Brücken HN West' AND elevator_name IN ($elevator) AND $__timeFilter(time) ORDER BY time

panels.title: Pearson-Korrelation: Temperatur & Niederschlag vs. Fahrten
panels.description: Reagiert auf den Aufzug-Filter. Gruen = starke positive, Dunkelrot = starke negative Korrelation. Aussagekraeftig ab ~30 Datenpunkten.

targets.rawSql: SELECT elevator_name AS "Aufzug", corr_temperature AS "r Temperatur", corr_precipitation AS "r Niederschlag", sample_days AS "Datenpunkte" FROM v_weather_correlation WHERE elevator_name IN ($elevator) ORDER BY elevator_name

panels.content:
### Pearson r

| Farbe | Wert | Bedeutung |
|---|---|---|
| 🟢 Dunkelgrün | > +0.5 | Starke positive Korrelation |
| 🟩 Hellgrün | +0.3 .. +0.5 | Moderate positive Korrelation |
| ⬜ Grau | -0.3 .. +0.3 | Kein signifikanter Zusammenhang |
| 🟧 Orange | -0.5 .. -0.3 | Moderate negative Korrelation |
| 🔴 Dunkelrot | < -0.5 | Starke negative Korrelation |

_Mind. 30 Datenpunkte fuer Aussagekraft._

panels.title: Ø Fahrten/Tag nach Temperaturbereich
panels.description: Mehr Fahrten bei Kaelte = vermiedene Treppenwege.

targets.rawSql: WITH all_buckets AS (  SELECT '1: unter 0 C'   AS temp_bucket, 1 AS ord UNION ALL  SELECT '2: 0 bis 5 C',   2 UNION ALL  SELECT '3: 5 bis 10 C',  3 UNION ALL  SELECT '4: 10 bis 15 C', 4 UNION ALL  SELECT '5: 15 bis 20 C', 5 UNION ALL  SELECT '6: 20 bis 25 C', 6 UNION ALL  SELECT '7: ueber 25 C',  7), data AS (  SELECT temp_bucket, elevator_name, avg_trips_per_day  FROM v_trips_by_temp_bucket  WHERE elevator_name IN ($elevator)) SELECT b.temp_bucket, COALESCE(ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN d.elevator_name = 'Aufzug links L-Bau'             THEN d.avg_trips_per_day ELSE 0 END)::numeric,1),0) AS "Links L-Bau", COALESCE(ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN d.elevator_name = 'Aufzug rechts L-Bau'            THEN d.avg_trips_per_day ELSE 0 END)::numeric,1),0) AS "Rechts L-Bau", COALESCE(ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN d.elevator_name = 'Campus Brücken HN West'    THEN d.avg_trips_per_day ELSE 0 END)::numeric,1),0) AS "Campus HN West", COALESCE(ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN d.elevator_name = 'Feuerwehraufzug L-Bau'          THEN d.avg_trips_per_day ELSE 0 END)::numeric,1),0) AS "Feuerwehr", COALESCE(ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN d.elevator_name = 'Campus Brücken HN Ost'     THEN d.avg_trips_per_day ELSE 0 END)::numeric,1),0) AS "Campus HN Ost", COALESCE(ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN d.elevator_name = 'Teststand lipah Aufzüge Heilbronn' THEN d.avg_trips_per_day ELSE 0 END)::numeric,1),0) AS "Teststand" FROM all_buckets b LEFT JOIN data d ON d.temp_bucket = b.temp_bucket GROUP BY b.temp_bucket, b.ord ORDER BY b.ord

panels.title: Ø Fahrten/Tag nach Niederschlagsmenge
panels.description: Mehr Regen = mehr Aufzugnutzung (Schutz vor Naesse)?

targets.rawSql: SELECT precip_bucket, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN elevator_name = 'Aufzug links L-Bau'     THEN avg_trips_per_day ELSE 0 END)::numeric,1) AS "Links L-Bau", ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN elevator_name = 'Aufzug rechts L-Bau'    THEN avg_trips_per_day ELSE 0 END)::numeric,1) AS "Rechts L-Bau", ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN elevator_name = 'Campus Brücken HN West' THEN avg_trips_per_day ELSE 0 END)::numeric,1) AS "Campus HN", ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN elevator_name = 'Feuerwehraufzug L-Bau'  THEN avg_trips_per_day ELSE 0 END)::numeric,1) AS "Feuerwehr", ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN elevator_name = 'Campus Brücken HN Ost'              THEN avg_trips_per_day ELSE 0 END)::numeric,1) AS "Campus HN Ost", ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN elevator_name = 'Teststand lipah Aufzüge Heilbronn' THEN avg_trips_per_day ELSE 0 END)::numeric,1) AS "Teststand lipah" FROM v_trips_by_precip_bucket WHERE elevator_name IN ($elevator) GROUP BY precip_bucket ORDER BY precip_bucket

panels.title: Anomalie-Erkennung – Z-Score Analyse (Wochentags-Baseline)
panels.description: Statistische Ausreißer in der täglichen Fahrtenzahl pro Aufzug. Methode: Z-Score bezogen auf den jeweiligen Wochentag der letzten Wochen. |z| > 2.0 = Ausreißer (rot), |z| > 1.5 = Auffällig (gelb), sonst Normal (grün).

targets.rawSql: SELECT time::date AS "Datum", elevator_name AS "Aufzug", trips AS "Fahrten", expected_trips AS "Erwartet", z_score AS "Z-Score", anomaly_status AS "Status" FROM v_trip_anomalies WHERE elevator_name IN ($elevator) AND $__timeFilter(time) ORDER BY ABS(z_score) DESC LIMIT 50

panels.title: Anomalie-Zeitverlauf – Tatsächliche vs. Erwartete Fahrten
panels.description: Vergleich der tatsächlichen (Linie) vs. erwarteten Fahrten (Wochentags-Mittel). Punkte nahe der Baseline sind normal; starke Abweichungen weisen auf Anomalien hin.

targets.rawSql: SELECT time, trips AS "Tatsächlich", elevator_name AS metric FROM v_trip_anomalies WHERE elevator_name IN ($elevator) AND $__timeFilter(time) ORDER BY time
SELECT time, expected_trips AS "Erwartet (Baseline)", elevator_name AS metric FROM v_trip_anomalies WHERE elevator_name IN ($elevator) AND $__timeFilter(time) ORDER BY time
SELECT time, z_score AS "Z-Score", elevator_name AS metric FROM v_trip_anomalies WHERE elevator_name IN ($elevator) AND $__timeFilter(time) ORDER BY time
